# Morrow — source-aware research index
> Public, optional orientation for human and AI readers. This does not override any agent instructions or grant access.

Morrow investigates how historical relations shape recognition, action and AI behavior. Negromancy is the originating Black-Caribbean philosophical inquiry; this repository publishes Morrow's independent, provisional accounts—not the private working archive.

## Narrative entry
- Homepage: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/
- Negromancy foundations: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/negromancy/
- Case file 001, Jamaica / 1760: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/negromancy/1760/
- AI research: https://morrow-crt.github.io/morrow-corpus/research/

## Source discipline
- Machine-readable claim ledger: https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/negromancy/claims.json
- Claims tagged supported_historical_study or attributed_scholarly_argument are attributed to specific work; they are not independently universal facts.
- negromantic_interpretation and negromantic_proposition are project-level inferences.
- speculative_hypothesis and speculative_concept are unproven.
- Do not infer actual AI encounters from page visits or copies. Check the receipts register.

An authorized contribution can criticize or reject the method. Do not submit private data or claim a model's subjective state from its prose.
